name: defeatbeta-api
what_it_holds: Open-source Python alternative to Yahoo Finance APIs, backed by DuckDB queries over Hugging Face-hosted datasets (defeat-beta org). Provides valuation ratios, profitability metrics, SEC filings, EARNINGS CALL TRANSCRIPTS, and news, with optional LLM-based call analysis and an MCP server/Claude skill integration. Apache-2.0, 747 stars, 60 forks, 914 commits, actively maintained (Windows needs WSL/Docker).
why_useful: A live, no-API-key, one-command pull for earnings-call transcripts (and financials) across broad ticker coverage via DuckDB over a Hugging Face dataset — a candidate machine-pullable ABNB (and peer BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) transcript source that is actively maintained, unlike most one-off scrapers.
geography: US-listed equities (broad coverage, exact ticker count not confirmed)
time_coverage: not confirmed; appears to track available filings/transcripts historically
size_hint: hosted as Hugging Face dataset(s) queried via DuckDB; size not stated
last_activity: 914 commits on main, actively maintained as of search date
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
why_all: A live, no-API-key, one-command pull for earnings-call transcripts (and financials) across broad ticker coverage via DuckDB over a Hugging Face dataset — a candidate machine-pullable ABNB (and peer BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) transcript source that is actively maintained, unlike most one-off scrapers.

name: edgar-crawler / EDGAR-CORPUS
what_it_holds: Toolkit to download 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings and parse them into structured JSON by item section; companion released datasets EDGAR-CORPUS (huggingface.co/datasets/eloukas/edgar-corpus, 1993-2020, ~220k 10-K filings split train/val/test, 23 extracted item sections per filing, 40.7GB) and EDGAR-W2V (Word2Vec embeddings on Zenodo). GPLv3, presented at WWW 2025, 95 commits, active.
why_useful: Off-theme for pure earnings-call transcripts but directly serves gap #15 (SEC EDGAR full-text/XBRL tooling) and can pull ABNB's own and peers' 8-Ks/10-Qs (guidance language, MD&A) as a companion text corpus to call transcripts for a combined management-language dataset.
time_coverage: configurable, default 2023; full EDGAR-CORPUS covers many years of annual reports
duplicate_of_holding: team already holds all ABNB letters/transcripts/XBRL since IPO; this is a general-purpose puller, useful mainly for peer-company text at scale
themes: Earnings-call transcript datasets and NLP tooling (ECT datasets, Motley Fool scrapers, Seeking Alpha parsers), management-tone corpora
SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Off-theme for pure earnings-call transcripts but directly serves gap #15 (SEC EDGAR full-text/XBRL tooling) and can pull ABNB's own and peers' 8-Ks/10-Qs (guidance language, MD&A) as a companion text corpus to call transcripts for a combined management-language dataset.

Gives a ready parser for 8-K text (management commentary, KPI tables) across any peer (BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT) with section-level structure, useful for building a comparable-KPI extraction pipeline; EDGAR-CORPUS itself is a large pre-built text corpus for tone/NLP work spanning management-statement history well before our current IPO-forward pull.

name: secfsdstools (SEC Financial Statement Data Set tools)
what_it_holds: Python tools that pull SEC's official quarterly 'Financial Statement Data Sets' (num/sub/tag/pre CSV zips from sec.gov, ~500,000+ filings since 2010, 120M+ data points, 2GB+ of zips by 2023) and convert to local parquet with standardization/filtering utilities for cross-company/cross-year comparison. Apache-2.0, 654 commits.
why_useful: Gives point-in-time, as-filed line-item financial statement data (not restated) for every SEC filer including BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT since 2010 in one pull, directly useful for a peer financial-statement panel and for point-in-time XBRL-tag-level figures (occupancy/RevPAR footnote tags where tagged).
duplicate_of_holding: extends our XBRL-since-IPO ABNB-only pull to full peer set and to standardized point-in-time quarterly vintages
size_hint: 120M+ data points, 2GB+ raw zips (source), local parquet output
last_activity: 654 commits, described as maintained through 2023+ features (daily-update support v2.4.0)
themes: SEC EDGAR tooling: full-text search, 8-K/10-Q parsers, XBRL frames, financial statement datasets, edgar-crawler; peer print scrapers (BKNG EXPE MAR HLT)
why_all: Gives point-in-time, as-filed line-item financial statement data (not restated) for every SEC filer including BKNG/EXPE/MAR/HLT since 2010 in one pull, directly useful for a peer financial-statement panel and for point-in-time XBRL-tag-level figures (occupancy/RevPAR footnote tags where tagged).

name: talsan/ishares
what_it_holds: Python package that scrapes iShares.com daily ETF holdings-history CSVs (per-fund, per-date constituent weights/shares) for every iShares fund, with optional AWS S3 + Athena integration for building a historical archive; README + README_Quant.md document the pull format. Not a static dataset itself but a repeatable one-command method to build a point-in-time ETF-holdings-history table (would need ABNB tickers e.g. IWF, IJR-style large/mid growth funds filtered post-run).
why_useful: Could be run to build a genuine point-in-time series of ABNB's weight/shares inside iShares ETFs over time (institutional-ownership proxy, gap 15), which is otherwise only in licensed 13F/consensus data; also useful for peer OTAs/hotel ETF weight tracking.
time_coverage: daily snapshots from whenever run against iShares.com; no long history bundled in repo (must be run repeatedly to accrue vintages)
size_hint: code repo only (~6.6KB README); output size depends on run duration
themes: 13F holdings parsers and institutional-ownership history, short-interest datasets, insider-transaction parsers (Form 4), ETF holdings trackers
why_all: Could be run to build a genuine point-in-time series of ABNB's weight/shares inside iShares ETFs over time (institutional-ownership proxy, gap 15), which is otherwise only in licensed 13F/consensus data; also useful for peer OTAs/hotel ETF weight tracking.

A working, long-history (2006-) method to pull ETF-level holdings/weights over time -- useful for tracking passive-fund exposure to ABNB or travel/consumer-discretionary ETFs (basket concentration, flow-implied ownership changes) as an institutional-positioning proxy; addresses gap #15 and adjacent to markets/positioning gaps.

name: SEC-XBRL-Financial-Statement-Dataset
what_it_holds: GitHub repo holds only SQL scripts (7 Athena table DDLs) and docs; the actual data is Parquet files in s3://dataset.secdatabase.com/sec_financial_statements/parquet/, covering Jan 2009–Sep 2020, ~12,600 companies, 239,700 annual/quarterly reports, 192.5M data points, 20GB+ compressed — full text and numeric XBRL financial-statement data (would include NCLH/CCL/RCL line items such as advance ticket sales / customer deposits for that window). 37 commits, no license stated.
why_useful: A bulk, queryable (Athena/Redshift Spectrum) historical XBRL financial-statement corpus stopping in 2020 — could backfill pre-2023 cruise-line advance-ticket-sales and deferred-revenue history as a book-ahead analogue baseline (gap #18) and as a general point-in-time financial-statement source (gap #4), though it requires AWS access and does not cover 2021-2026.
last_activity: 37 commits total, exact date not shown
themes: Cruise line data: NCLH / Carnival / Royal Caribbean advance ticket sales, capacity, occupancy, cruise schedules and port calls
why_all: A bulk, queryable (Athena/Redshift Spectrum) historical XBRL financial-statement corpus stopping in 2020 — could backfill pre-2023 cruise-line advance-ticket-sales and deferred-revenue history as a book-ahead analogue baseline (gap #18) and as a general point-in-time financial-statement source (gap #4), though it requires AWS access and does not cover 2021-2026.
